name: drafts
description: Develop, draft, and revise prose through a focused writing workflow.

interface.longDescription: Select Drafts with an idea, notes, or a draft. Scribe chooses and runs the writing workflow needed for your request. Call a focused writing skill directly when you know the pass you want. Keep voice and style guidance in your own writing workspace.
defaultPrompt: Use $scribe to help me develop an idea into a draft.
Use $reader to give my draft a fresh-eyes review.
Use $setup-project to set up my writing workspace.
